content.text: All research complete. Here is the concise structured summary. --- ## 1. How the web demos mount their root view **Quarkus** — `lib/java/pathland-quarkus-demo/src/main/java/com/pathland/demo/quarkus/QuarkusDemoApp.java` - `@Produces @Singleton PathlandApp mainApp()` (lines 24–28) → `demoApp()` - `@Produces @Singleton MountedApp secondaryApp()` (lines 31–35) → `MountedApp.of("/app2", demoApp())` - `demoApp()` (lines 37–49): anonymous `PathlandApp` whose `newRoot()` returns **`new SplitNavDemo()`** (line 41) and `theme()` returns `DemoTheme.adaptive()` (line 46). **Spring Boot** — `lib/java/pathland-spring-boot-demo/src/main/java/com/pathland/demo/spring/SpringDemoApplication.java` - `@Bean PathlandApp pathlandApp()` (lines 29–32) and `@Bean MountedApp pathlandApp2()` (lines 35–38, `/app2`) - Identical `demoApp()` (lines 40–52): `newRoot()` returns **`new SplitNavDemo()`** (line 44), `theme()` → `DemoTheme.adaptive()`. Both demos mount the same shared root view, **`com.pathland.demo.SplitNavDemo`** (`lib/java/pathland-demo-views/.../SplitNavDemo.java`). That view (lines 36–56) is a split master-detail: a `Navigation.navigator()` route table (`/`, `/home` → `HomeView`; `/kitchen` → `KitchenSinkView`; `/settings` → `SettingsView`; fallback) rendered as `HStack.of(new Sidebar(), ScrollView.of(Navigation.of(router)))`. **A music-player demo would either add a new route here or be a separate `newRoot()`.** ## 2. Static assets (album art) **Source locations** (the browser requests them as `/_pathland/assets/...`): - Spring: `lib/java/pathland-spring-boot-demo/src/main/resources/static/_pathland/assets/icons/*.svg` (e.g. `home.svg`, `settings.svg`) - Quarkus: `lib/java/pathland-quarkus-demo/src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/_pathland/assets/icons/*.svg` (same six icons) **Server mapping:** - Spring — `PathlandIndexController.java:69–89`: `@GetMapping("/_pathland/**", "/{app}/_pathland/**")` serves `classpath:static/_pathland/` (line 79); MIME via `MediaTypeFactory` (line 84, handles svg/mp3/mp4). - Quarkus — `IndexResource.java:52–60` (mounted-app framework paths fall through to `frameworkFile` → `META-INF/resources/_pathland/` at line 75; `mediaTypeOf` handles `.svg`/`.mp3`/`.mp4` at lines 83–97). Root `/_pathland/**` is served by Quarkus static resources from `META-INF/resources` before JAX-RS. **IMAGE resolution:** The `IMAGE_SOURCE` string is passed through verbatim into the HTML — the Rust SSR renderer emits `` (`lib/rust/crates/pathland-render-html/src/lib.rs:1002–1017`); the TypeScript DOM renderer applies live deltas to `img.src` (`lib/typescript/src/apply.ts:615–620`). So the source is a **server-served asset path or absolute URL** (spec/PRIMITIVES.md:246–259). Existing demo usage: `"/_pathland/assets/icons/home.svg"` (`Sidebar.java:26–28`, `LabelSection.java:26–32`). **Where to drop new files:** `.../pathland-spring-boot-demo/src/main/resources/static/_pathland/assets/` (e.g. a new `albumart/` subdir) and `.../pathland-quarkus-demo/src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/_pathland/assets/` — then reference e.g. `Image.of("/_pathland/assets/albumart/cover1.svg")`. Server-root-relative paths work at both `/` and `/app2` mounts. ## 3. Image view in the Java DSL - `lib/java/pathland-view/.../Image.java` — `Image.of()` (no source, line 19), `Image.of(String)` (line 24), `Image.of(Signal)` (line 29). `render()` (lines 34–41) sets `node.properties[Properties.IMAGE_SOURCE] = sourceSignal.get()` and a property binding — a signal change re-emits only this node's `SET_PROPERTY(IMAGE_SOURCE)`. `IMAGE_SOURCE = 0x1002` (`Properties.java:36`), STRING value type (`ValueTypes.java:26`). - `ImageSource.java` — `ImageSource.of(String)` is a `ViewModifier` (lines 14–21) applying `IMAGE_SOURCE`; chainable as `.with(ImageSource.of("..."))`. There is **no** `.image(...)` chainable method; the canonical authoring is `Image.of("path")` (or via `Label.of(title, icon)` which composes `Image` + `Text`, `Label.java:77–85`). - **ContentMode exists**: `ScaledToFit.of()` / `ScaledToFill.of()` (`ScaledToFit.java:15`, `ScaledToFill.java:15`) set `CONTENT_MODE` (0x001C, `ContentMode.FIT=0`/`FILL=1`, `ContentMode.java:4–17`); also `AspectRatio.of(ratio, mode)` (`AspectRatio.java:16`). The HTML renderer maps Fit→`object-fit:contain`, Fill→`object-fit:cover` (verified in `HtmlRendererTest.java:164–179`). Size via `FrameMod.of(w, h, alignment)`. ## 4.
